title: The hottest AI wearables and gadgets you should know about
script:
Bee offers a dedicated clip-on device designed to capture your daily interactions.
Friend provides a wearable pendant that functions as an emotional support companion.
Plaud introduces hardware that adds an instant AI note-taking layer to your routine.
These gadgets represent the newest wave of standalone AI hardware hitting the market.
Each device approaches personal technology through a different form factor.
Would you wear an AI companion on a necklace?
